_comment: Origin values are configuration, never constants (E1 §2). allowedOrigins are exact scheme://host[:port] origins — no wildcards, no paths. pageUrl must be inside allowedOrigins. portalOrigin is deliberately NOT in allowedOrigins: a navigation towards it is the re-auth signal, refused here and answered host-side (E2). gatewayUrl is the identity authority (refresh / ticket exchange / logout / agent key / turns / web_search) and the host of the injected session cookies; chatEdgeUrl is the page's conversation store (history, transcript import, rename, memories, run_python). Neither is allow-listed for navigation. protocolScheme is the DEV deep-link scheme (sran:// belongs to the WebView2 shell; production is an E6 decision); oauthClient maps to it on the backend. sessionRefreshMinutes must stay under the 60-minute portal access TTL (E2 §4). sidecarPath is the tools sidecar exe (E4), relative to the app root or absolute; approvalMode is the WPF app's manual|auto|skip; webSearchEnabled lists web_search only when true (WPF default: off). Override the whole file with SRAN_DESKTOP_CONFIG (absolute path).
contentSecurityPolicy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://localhost:4000 http://localhost:8080 http://localhost:8081; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' http://localhost:4000 http://localhost:8080 http://localhost:8081 http://localhost:3001; media-src 'self' blob: http://localhost:4000; frame-src 'self' blob: data:; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
